author: Fextralife
description:
How to use The Lady's Fan - Phantom Blade Zero Weapon Guide
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be showing you how to use The Lady's Fan. This is without a doubt the highest skill floor and highest skill ceiling weapon I have tested at this point. Considering how many weapons I have done, it is probably the highest skill floor and highlight skill ceiling of all the weapons. I haven't tested all of them yet, so I'm not sure that's 100% the case, but it's definitely a very complicated weapon compared to some of the other weapons in the game.
